newsitem.title: UK: NatWest CEO, chairman face ultimatum - paper.
newsitem.headline: NatWest CEO, chairman face ultimatum - paper.

text.p: Shareholders at Britain's National Westminster Bank Plc are set to warn the embattled bank's managers that they have a 12 month deadline to revive its fortunes, the Guardian newspaper said on Wednesday.
NatWest shocked the markets this week with a profits warning and the departure of its investment banking boss Martin Owen. Its shares dropped sharply.
The Guardian said the major large fund management groups would examine the performance and targets set by chief executive Derek Wanless and chairman Lord Alexander more closely.
